#### Supplementary Figure 1: 

Hierarchical clustering dendrogram of Gene Ontology Cellular Component
terms for significantly interacting (p-value \< 0.05) ligands and
receptors detected across subcellular regions in all nine spatial
transcriptomics datasets. Dendrogram shading indicates broad ontology
categories; node color represents FDR-adjusted p-values of enriched
terms, and node size reflects the number of genes in each GO term.
Panels A and C represent clustering of significantly interacting ligands
detected in cytoplasm and nucleus respectively and panels B and D
represent clustering of significantly interacting receptors detected in
cytoplasm and nucleus respectively.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 30
#| fig-height: 30 
#| label: gsea
# Gene set enrichment analysis ********************************************
data = fread("data/training_data/training_data.csv")
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
# download the go:cc onotology terms 
gs_cc <- setDT(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category="C5", subcategory="GO:CC"))
TERM2GENE  <- gs_cc[,.(term = gs_name, gene = gene_symbol)]
unique_genes_df <- read_csv("data/training_data/raw_data.csv")
universe_genes <- c(unique_genes_df$ligand, unique_genes_df$receptor)%>%unique()

run_ora <- function(detected_genes, universe_genes, TERM2GENE,
                    minGS = 10, maxGS = 500, p_adj = "BH") {
  detected_genes <- intersect(unique(detected_genes), universe_genes)
  # if (length(detected_genes) < 5) {
  #   return(data.table())  
  # }
  ora <- enricher(gene          = detected_genes,
                  TERM2GENE     = TERM2GENE,
                  universe      = universe_genes,
                  pAdjustMethod = p_adj,
                  minGSSize     = minGS,
                  maxGSSize     = maxGS)
  as.data.table(ora@result)[order(p.adjust)]
}

options(enrichplot.colours = c("#1B9E77","#D81B60"))

plot_ora_tree <- function(ora_dt, top = 15, title = "") {
  if (!nrow(ora_dt)) return(invisible(NULL))

  # build enrichResult object
  ora_obj <- new("enrichResult", result = as.data.frame(ora_dt))

  # keep top categories (by adjusted p)
  if (!is.null(ora_obj@result) && nrow(ora_obj@result) > top) {
    keep_ids <- head(ora_obj@result[order(ora_obj@result$p.adjust), "ID"], top)
    ora_obj@result <- ora_obj@result[ora_obj@result$ID %in% keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # compute pairwise term similarity then treeplot
  # requires enrichplot >= 1.20 and DOSE loaded as a dep
  if (requireNamespace("enrichplot", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ora_sim <- enrichplot::pairwise_termsim(ora_obj)
    if ("treeplot" %in% getNamespaceExports("enrichplot")) {
      p <- enrichplot::treeplot(ora_sim, showCategory = top, fontsize = 10,
                                extend = 1,
                                label_format_tiplab = 30,
                                label_format_cladelab = 20,
                                leave_fontsize = 4,
                                clade_fontsize = 4,
                                offset =8,
                                legend_n = 0,
                                geneClusterPanel = "dotplot",
                                group_color = c("#f27042",
                                                "#fcda83", "#b62e48", 
                                                "#7ecba4", "#4965b0"
                                                )) + ggtitle(title)
      return(p)
    } else {
      # fallback: enrichment map if treeplot not available
      p <- enrichplot::emapplot(ora_sim, showCategory = top) + ggtitle(paste0(title, " (emap)"))
      return(p)
    }
  } else {
    stop("Package 'enrichplot' is required for tree/emap plots. Install with BiocManager::install('enrichplot').")
  }
}

# Suppose you have four enrichment results
padj_min <- min(c(res_lig_cyt$p.adjust,
                  res_lig_nuc$p.adjust,
                  res_rec_cyt$p.adjust,
                  res_rec_nuc$p.adjust))

padj_max <- max(c(res_lig_cyt$p.adjust,
                  res_lig_nuc$p.adjust,
                  res_rec_cyt$p.adjust,
                  res_rec_nuc$p.adjust))

gene_ratio_min <- 0
gene_ratio_max <- max(c(res_lig_cyt$Count,
                        res_lig_nuc$Count,
                        res_rec_cyt$Count,
                        res_rec_nuc$Count))


p1 = plot_ora_tree(res_lig_cyt, top = 17, title = "A. Ligands - Cytoplasm") +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#1B9E77", "#1B9E77","#D81B60", "#D81B60"),  # repeated colors
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.05, 0.05, 1)),           # cutoff at 0.05
    limits = c(0, 1),                                        # full range
    name = "FDR-adjusted p-value"
  )+ 
      scale_size_continuous(limits = c(gene_ratio_min, gene_ratio_max), name = "Number of genes") +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
p2 = plot_ora_tree(res_lig_nuc, top = 17, title = "B. Ligands - Nucleus") + 
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#1B9E77", "#1B9E77","#D81B60", "#D81B60"),  # repeated colors
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.05, 0.05, 1)),           # cutoff at 0.05
    limits = c(0, 1),                                        # full range
    name = "FDR-adjusted p-value"
  ) + 
  scale_size_continuous(limits = c(gene_ratio_min, gene_ratio_max), name = "Number of genes") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p3 = plot_ora_tree(res_rec_cyt, top = 17, title = "C. Receptors - Cytoplasm") + 
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#1B9E77", "#1B9E77","#D81B60", "#D81B60"),  # repeated colors
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.05, 0.05, 1)),           # cutoff at 0.05
    limits = c(0, 1),                                        # full range
    name = "FDR-adjusted p-value"
  ) + 
  scale_size_continuous(limits = c(gene_ratio_min, gene_ratio_max), name = "Number of genes") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p4 = plot_ora_tree(res_rec_nuc, top = 17, title = "D. Receptors - Nucleus") + 
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("#1B9E77", "#1B9E77","#D81B60", "#D81B60"),  # repeated colors
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.05, 0.05, 1)),           # cutoff at 0.05
    limits = c(0, 1),                                        # full range
    name = "FDR-adjusted p-value"
  ) + 
  scale_size_continuous(limits = c(gene_ratio_min, gene_ratio_max), name = "Number of genes") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

combined <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) &
  theme(                       # applies to ALL subplots uniformly
    text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 0)
  )
combined
ggsave('data/results/Final_Figures/Final_figure1/overlap_test_tree.pdf', height = 15, width = 20)

p1 + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

#### Supplementary Figure 4: 

Principal component analysis (PCA) of CellChat-derived communication
score components across the whole cell (left), cytoplasm (middle), and
nucleus (right) for all the 9 subcellularly resolved spatial
transcriptomics datasets. Each point represents a ligand–receptor (LR)
pair and is colored by the P1 value, defined as the Hill function of LR
expression.

#### Supplementary Figure 2: 

Upset plots of the significantly communicating LR communicating between
each of the subcellular regions for all the 9 subcellularly resolved
spatial transcriptomics datasets. A. Brain (AD), B. Brain (GL), C.
Breast Cancer, D. Lung, E. Lung (High-Res), F. Lymph Node, G. Pancreas,
H. Ovarian, I. Skin. N - Nucleus, C - Cytoplasm, WC - whole cell, AD -
Alzheimer's Disease, GL - Glioblastoma

```{r}
#| message: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| label: upset-plots
data <- fread("data/training_data/training_data.csv") 
data$unique_id = paste0(data$lr_pair, "_", data$source, "_", data$target)
venn_data = list()
plot_list = list()
for (i in unique(data$sample)){
  subset = data[sample == i,]
  data_list = list(
    `WC-->WC` = as.vector(subset[cell_pval <0.05 & cell_score >0,unique_id]),
    `C-->C` = as.vector(subset[cyt_pval <0.05 & cyt_score > 0,unique_id]),
    `N-->N` = as.vector(subset[nuc_pval <0.05& nuc_score > 0,unique_id])
  )
  venn_data[[i]] = data_list
}


files = list.files('data/processed/cyt_to_nuc') # cyt to nuc and nuc to cyt (run the bin/cytnuc_nuccyt.R)
cyt_to_nuc = list()
nuc_to_cyt = list()
for (i in files){
  filename = gsub(".rds", "", i)
  obj = readRDS(file.path('data/processed/cyt_to_nuc', i))
  scores <- as.data.frame(as.table(obj[["Prob_P2_P3_P4"]]))
  pval <- as.data.frame(as.table(obj[["PvalP2_P3_P4"]]))
  colnames(scores) = c("source", "target", "lr_pair", "score")
  colnames(pval) = c("source", "target", "lr_pair", "pval")
  df = setDT(inner_join(scores, pval, by = intersect(colnames(scores), colnames(pval))))
  df$unique_id = paste0(df$lr_pair, "_", df$source, "_", df$target)
  cyt_to_nuc[[filename]] = df[pval<0.05,unique_id]
  obj = readRDS(file.path('data/processed/nuc_to_cyt', i))
  scores <- as.data.frame(as.table(obj[["Prob_P2_P3_P4"]]))
  pval <- as.data.frame(as.table(obj[["PvalP2_P3_P4"]]))
  colnames(scores) = c("source", "target", "lr_pair", "score")
  colnames(pval) = c("source", "target", "lr_pair", "pval")
  df = setDT(inner_join(scores, pval, by = intersect(colnames(scores), colnames(pval))))
  df$unique_id = paste0(df$lr_pair, "_", df$source, "_", df$target)
  nuc_to_cyt[[filename]] = df[pval<0.05,unique_id]
}

# add cyt-nuc to the venn data
for (i in names(venn_data)){
  venn_data[[i]][['C-->N']] = cyt_to_nuc[[i]]
  venn_data[[i]][['N-->C']] = nuc_to_cyt[[i]]
}

names(venn_data) = c("Brain (AD)",
             "Brain (GL)",
             "Breast Cancer",
             "Lung",
             "Lung (High-Res)",
             "Lymph Node",
             "Ovarian",
             "Pancreas",
             "Skin")
upset_plots = list()
interactions = c(10, 11, 4, 17, 21, 15, 8, 7, 16)
save_dir = "data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/upset_plots"
for (i in 1:length(names(venn_data))){
  filename = file.path(save_dir, paste0(names(venn_data)[[i]], ".pdf"))
  pdf(filename)
  list = venn_data[[names(venn_data)[i]]]
  venn = Venn(list)
  p = plot_upset(venn, min_size = 1, nintersects = interactions[i], 
                 top.bar.color = "#3C3B6E", 
                 sets.bar.color = "#B22234",
                 intersection.matrix.color = "darkgreen",
                 top.bar.numbers.size = 6,
                 relative_height = 4,
                 relative_width = 0.4
                 )
  
  p[["plotlist"]][[2]] = p[["plotlist"]][[2]] + ggtitle(names(venn_data)[i]) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  p[["plotlist"]][[3]] = p[["plotlist"]][[3]] + theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  p[["plotlist"]][[1]] = p[["plotlist"]][[1]] + theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

#### Supplementary Figure 3: 

Distribution of communication scores in each 9 subcellularly resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets across the cell and its subcellular regions. Only the significantly communicating ligand receptor pairs (p-value \< 0.05) that were identified in all three regions (cell, cytoplasm and nucleus) are shown. A. Brain (AD), B. Brain (GL), C. Breast Cancer D. Lung, E. Lung (High-Res), F. Lymph Node, G. Pancreas, H. Ovarian, I. Skin.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| label: boxplots
box_data <- data[(nuc_pval < 0.05) | (cyt_pval < 0.05) | (cell_pval < 0.05), .(cell_score, cell_P1, cyt_score, cyt_P1, nuc_score, nuc_P1, sample)]
box_data <- box_data %>%
  mutate(compartment = case_when(
    cyt_score > 0 & nuc_score > 0 & cell_score > 0 ~ "cell+cyt+nuc",
    cyt_score == 0 & nuc_score == 0 & cell_score > 0 ~ "cell",
    cyt_score > 0 & nuc_score > 0 & cell_score == 0 ~ "cyt+nuc",
    cyt_score == 0 & nuc_score > 0 & cell_score > 0 ~ "cell+nuc",
    cyt_score == 0 & nuc_score > 0 & cell_score == 0 ~ "nuc",
    cyt_score > 0 & nuc_score == 0 & cell_score == 0 ~ "cyt",
    cyt_score > 0 & nuc_score == 0 & cell_score > 0 ~ "cell+cyt",
    TRUE ~ "none"   # fallback in case none of the conditions match
  ))
box_data$sample = factor(box_data$sample, unique(box_data$sample), 
                         labels = c("Brain (AD)",
             "Brain (GL)",
             "Breast Cancer",
             "Lung",
             "Lung (High-Res)",
             "Lymph Node",
             "Ovarian",
             "Pancreas",
             "Skin"))
colnames(box_data) = c('cell', 'cell_P1', 'cytoplasm', 'cyt_P1', 'nucleus', 'nuc_P1', 'sample', 'compartment')
cell_cyt_data <- box_data[compartment == "cell+cyt"]
cell_nuc_data <- box_data[compartment == "cell+nuc"]
cell_cyt_nuc_data <- box_data[compartment == "cell+cyt+nuc"]

cell_cyt_long <- melt(cell_cyt_data[,.(cell, cytoplasm, sample)],measure.vars = c("cell", "cytoplasm"),variable.name = "Compartment",value.name = "Score")
cell_nuc_long <- melt(cell_nuc_data[,.(cell, nucleus, sample)],measure.vars = c("cell", "nucleus"),variable.name = "Compartment",value.name = "Score")
cell_cyt_nuc_long <- melt(cell_cyt_nuc_data[,.(cell, cytoplasm, nucleus, sample)],measure.vars = c("cell", "cytoplasm", "nucleus"),variable.name = "Compartment",value.name = "Score")
setDT(cell_cyt_long)
setDT(cell_nuc_long)
setDT(cell_cyt_nuc_long)
cell_cyt_long[, log_Score := log10(Score + 1e-10)] 
cell_nuc_long[, log_Score := log10(Score + 1e-10)] 
cell_cyt_nuc_long[, log_Score := log10(Score + 1e-10)] 

plotdir = "data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/compare_ditributions/"
ggboxplot(
  cell_cyt_nuc_long, 
  x = "Compartment", 
  y = "log_Score",
  color = "black", 
  fill = "Compartment", 
  palette = c("#b089c0", "#97c9c8", "#ea9b8e"),  # colorblind-friendly
  add = "jitter", 
  add.params = list(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.3, width = 0.1)
) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample,ncol = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(
      c("cell", "cytoplasm"),
      c("cell", "nucleus"),
      c("cytoplasm", "nucleus")
    ),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(log[10]~"Communication scores"),
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "lightgray", fill = NA, size = 1), # box around each facet
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
ggsave(file.path(plotdir, 'cellvscytvsnuc.pdf'), height = 15)
```

```{r}
dt = rbind(xgb, rf, xgb_rf, xgb_voting)
```

```{r}
count_function = function(data){
  shift_val = min(0, min(data$pred))
  data$score = data$pred - shift_val
  # compute the network plot
  links = data.table(
    source= data$source,
    target= data$target,
    importance= data$score
    )
  edges_count <- links[, .(count = .N), by = .(source, target)]
  edges_sum   <- links[, .(sum = sum(importance, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                     by = .(source, target)]
  nodes <- unique(c(links$source, links$target))
  all_pairs <- CJ(source = nodes, target = nodes, unique=TRUE)
  matrix <- merge(all_pairs, edges_count, by=c("source","target"), all.x=TRUE)
  matrix <- merge(matrix, edges_sum,   by=c("source","target"), all.x=TRUE)
  matrix[is.na(count), count := 0]
  matrix[is.na(sum),   sum   := 0]
}

plot(network, vertex.color=coul, edge.width=0.2*(E(network)$weight), main = "Cyt Network (sum)", layout=layout.circle)
plots_sum = recordPlot()

data = nucleus
# shift the scale

data$score = data$pred - shift_val
# compute the network plot

  target= data$target,
  importance= data$score
  )

edges_sum   <- links[, .(weight = sum(importance, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                   by = .(source, target)]
nodes = unique(c(data$source, data$target))
network <- graph_from_data_frame(d=edges_count, vertices=nodes, directed=F)
```

## Sensitivity analysis

```{r}
metrics = fread("data/processed/revisions/sensitivity_metrics.csv")
metrics[ , `Composite Metric` := (auc * (1 - ((cyt_NRMSE + nuc_NRMSE)/2)) 
                         * macro_recall 
                         * ((`cyt_R²` + `nuc_R²`)/2)
)**(1/4)]


# 1. Prepare data frame and drop unwanted weighted metrics
df <- as.data.frame(metrics)

metric_cols <- c(
  "Class_0 F1", "Class_0 Precision", "Class_0 Recall",
  "Class_1 F1", "Class_1 Precision", "Class_1 Recall", 
  "accuracies", "auc",
  "macro_f1", "macro_precision", "macro_recall",
  "cyt_R²", "cyt_RMSE", "cyt_NRMSE",
  "nuc_R²", "nuc_RMSE", "nuc_NRMSE",
  "Composite Metric"
)

# Subset and flip error metrics so higher values always mean better performance
df_sub <- df[, c("Dataset", metric_cols)]
colnames(df_sub) = c("Dataset",
  "F1 (Class 0)", "Precision (Class 0)", "Recall (Class 0)",
  "F1 (Class 1)", "Precision (Class 1)", "Recall (Class 1) ", 
  "Accuracy", "AUC",
  "Macro F1", "Macro Precision", "Recall (Macro)",
  "R²- Cytoplasm", "RMSE - Cytoplasm", "NRMSE - Cytoplasm",
  "R² - Nucleus", "RMSE - Nucleus", "NRMSE - Nucleus",
  "Composite Metric"
)
# 2. Reshape from wide to long format for ggplot
df_long <- pivot_longer(
  df_sub, 
  cols = colnames(df_sub)[-1], 
  names_to = "Metric", 
  values_to = "Performance"
)

df_long$Metric <- factor(df_long$Metric, levels = colnames(df_sub))

# 4. Create the boxplot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Metric, y = Performance, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1f77b4","#3a99d9","#5cb0e0","#7fc7e6","#a3d5eb","#c7e3f0","#fdb462","#fec978","#fee0a3", "#fccb53", "#fdd575","#9467bd","#b087d0","#eb98fd", "#eea9fe", "#f5cbfe", "#dd53fc", "#fae79e")) +
  labs(
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Performance Score",
    fill = "Metric Group"
  )
ggsave("data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/revisions/sensitiivity.pdf", width =7)
ggsave("data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/revisions/sensitiivity.png", width =7)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
metrics = fread("CCIDeconv/supplementary_analysis/results/mean_allocation_ablations/dataset_level_comparison.csv")
metrics[, `Composite Metric` := (
  auc * (1 - ((cyt_nrmse + nuc_nrmse) / 2)) * 
    macro_recall * 
    ((cyt_r2 + nuc_r2) / 2)
)^(1 / 4)]

metric_cols <- c("auc", "macro_recall", "cyt_r2", "nuc_r2", "cyt_nrmse", "nuc_nrmse", "Composite Metric")

metrics_long <- melt(
  metrics,
  measure.vars = metric_cols,
  variable.name = "Metric",
  value.name = "Value"
)

metrics_long = metrics_long[,c(1,2,3,6,7)]

cascading_metrics <- fread("CCIDeconv/supplementary_analysis/results/cascading_metrics/cascading_metrics_dataset_level.csv")
cascading_metrics = cascading_metrics[cascading_metrics$evaluation_mode == "End-to-End (Physical Zero)" & cascading_metrics$metric %in% c("cyt_nrmse", "nuc_nrmse", "cyt_r2", "nuc_r2"),]
cascading_metrics = cascading_metrics[, c(1,2,4,3,5)]
colnames(cascading_metrics) = colnames(metrics_long)

# add the auc and macro recall values to the cascading metrics 
cascading_metrics_long = rbind(cascading_metrics, metrics_long[method== "CCIDeconv" & Metric %in% c("auc", "macro_recall")])
cascading_metrics_long$method = "End-End"
id_cols <- setdiff(names(cascading_metrics), c("Metric", "Value"))
cascading_wide <- dcast(
  cascading_metrics_long,
  as.formula(paste(paste(id_cols, collapse = " + "), "~ Metric")),
  value.var = "Value"
)
cascading_wide[, `Composite Metric` := (
  auc * (1 - ((cyt_nrmse + nuc_nrmse) / 2)) * 
    macro_recall * 
    ((cyt_r2 + nuc_r2) / 2)
)^(1 / 4)]

metric_cols_cascading <- c("auc", "macro_recall", "cyt_r2", "nuc_r2", "cyt_nrmse", "nuc_nrmse", "Composite Metric")
cascading_long <- melt(
  cascading_wide,
  measure.vars = c(4:10),
  variable.name = "Metric",
  value.name = "Value"
)

metrics_long_new = rbind(cascading_long, metrics_long)   


metrics_long_new$Metric <- factor(metrics_long_new$Metric,
                      levels = c("auc","macro_recall","cyt_r2","nuc_r2",
                                 # "cyt_RMSE","nuc_RMSE",
                                 "cyt_nrmse","nuc_nrmse","Composite Metric"),
                      labels = c("AUC",
                                 "Recall (Macro)",
                                 "R² – Cytoplasm",
                                 "R² – Nucleus",
                                 # "RMSE – Cytoplasm",
                                 # "RMSE – Nucleus",
                                 "NRMSE – Cytoplasm",
                                 "NRMSE – Nucleus",
                                 "Composite metric"))
metrics_long_new$procedure = factor(metrics_long_new$procedure, levels = c("SP", "ScP"))
metrics_long_new = metrics_long_new[method != "CCIDeconv without whole-cell score"]

metrics_long_new$method <- factor(metrics_long_new$method,
                      levels = c("CCIDeconv","End-End","Direct assignment","HPA proportional split",
                                 # "cyt_RMSE","nuc_RMSE",
                                 "Mean allocation"))

library(rstatix)
ref_method <- "CCIDeconv"
other_methods <- setdiff(unique(metrics_long_new$method), ref_method)
ref_pairs <- lapply(other_methods, function(x) c(ref_method, x))

stat_data <- metrics_long_new %>%
  group_by(procedure, Metric) %>%
  wilcox_test(Value ~ method, comparisons = ref_pairs) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_y_position(fun = "max", step.increase = 0.05) # Removed the invalid argument
stat_data_filtered <- stat_data %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns")
ggplot(metrics_long_new, aes(x = method, y = Value, fill = method)) +
  geom_violin(width = 1) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, color = "black", fill = "beige", outlier.size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(procedure ~ Metric, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "#A8D5BA",  # Pastel green
    "#79C7A5",  # Soft mint green
    "#D0E8D0",  # Pale sage green
    "#A7C7E7",  # Pastel blue
    "#C5DDF5"   # Powder blue
  )) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_data_filtered, 
    label = "p.adj.signif", 
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = 'Value'
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 13, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 7)) # Cleanly bounded between 0 and 1.35!
ggsave("data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/revisions/baseline_allocations.pdf", width =13, height = 10)
ggsave("data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/revisions/baseline_allocations.png", width =13, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# ablation result to go in table
metrics = metrics[method == "CCIDeconv without whole-cell score"]
summary(metrics)
```

# domain shift analysis

```{r}
df <- read_csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-TheUniversityofSydney(Students)/University of Sydney/PhD projects/main/Cell Cell Communication/server/cell_cell_commuication/CCIDeconv/supplementary_analysis/results/domain_shift_analysis/domain_shift_dataset_level.csv")

library(rstatix)   # install.packages("rstatix") if needed

# one value per dataset per shift (averages the 5 noise repeats), so the paired test is valid
dd <- d %>%
  group_by(dataset, panel, shift, family) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# paired Wilcoxon of each shift vs Baseline, Holm-adjusted within each panel
stats <- dd %>%
  arrange(dataset) %>%                       # same dataset order in every group
  group_by(panel) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(value ~ shift, ref.group = "Baseline",
                       paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05)

# put a label above the box of each significant shift
ypos <- dd %>%
  group_by(panel, shift) %>% summarise(y = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(panel = as.character(panel), shift = as.character(shift))

sig <- stats %>%
  mutate(panel = as.character(panel),
         shift = ifelse(group1 == "Baseline", group2, group1)) %>%
  left_join(ypos, by = c("panel", "shift")) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = levels(dd$panel)),
         shift = factor(shift, levels = levels(dd$shift)))

p <- ggplot(dd, aes(shift, value, fill = family)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = sig, aes(shift, y, label = p.adj.signif), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = -0.3, size = 4, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +   # room for the stars
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Perturbation") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0))
p

# ---- Save ----
out_dir <- "data/results/Final_Figures/Supplementary_figures/revisions"
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "domain_shift.png"), p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "domain_shift.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 7)
```

## Correlation of nuclear compartments

```{r}
getwd()
data <- fread("CCIDEconv/supplementary_analysis/results/nuclear_compartment_analysis/correlation_analysis_results.csv")
plot_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # Separate the domain (SP/ScP) and the type of analysis (LOGO/Robustness)
    domain = case_when(
      analysis %in% c("spatial_logo", "spatial_robustness") ~ "SP",
      analysis %in% c("single_logo", "single_robustness") ~ "ScP"
    ),
    analysis_type = case_when(
      analysis %in% c("spatial_logo", "single_logo") ~ "LOGO",
      analysis %in% c("spatial_robustness", "single_robustness") ~ "Robustness"
    ),
    performance_metric = recode(
      performance_metric,
      "Nuclear R²"    = "Nuclear R²",
      "Nuclear NRMSE" = "Nuclear NRMSE",
      "ΔR²"           = "Nuclear ΔR²",
      "ΔNRMSE"        = "Nuclear ΔNRMSE"  
    ),
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = rev(c(
        "Nuclear detected genes",
        "Nuclear zero-count fraction",
        "N/C expression ratio",
        "Nuclear–cytoplasmic dropout gap",
        "Nuclear detection ratio",
        "Total panel gene count"
      ))
    ),
    # Combine domain and metric with a newline so labels stay compact
    metric_analysis = paste(domain, performance_metric, sep = " "),
    metric_analysis = factor(
      metric_analysis,
      levels = c(
        "SP Nuclear R²",
        "SP Nuclear NRMSE",
        "SP Nuclear ΔR²",
        "SP Nuclear ΔNRMSE",
        "ScP Nuclear R²",
        "ScP Nuclear NRMSE",
        "ScP Nuclear ΔR²",
        "ScP Nuclear ΔNRMSE"
      )
    ),
    label = sprintf("%.2f", correlation)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(metric_analysis) %>% 
  filter(performance_metric %in% c("Nuclear ΔR²","Nuclear ΔNRMSE"))

# 2x2 Layout: rows = analysis_type (LOGO top, Robustness bottom), columns = method (Pearson left, Spearman right)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = metric_analysis, y = predictor, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", correlation)), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Correlation"
  ) +
  facet_grid(analysis_type ~ method) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 40, l = 10, unit = "pt")
  )
```

## sensitivity plot

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
})
base_dir <- getwd()
csv_path <- file.path(base_dir, "CCIDeconv", "supplementary_analysis", "results", "random_seed_sensitivity", "seed_sensitivity_per_dataset.csv")

df <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Seed = factor(paste0("Seed ", Seed), levels = c("Seed 42", "Seed 112", "Seed 123")))

# Select key metrics
metric_mapping <- c(
  "AUC"          = "AUROC",
  "macro_recall" = "Macro Recall",
  "cyt_R2"       = "Cytoplasm R²",
  "nuc_R2"       = "Nuclear R²"
)

plot_df <- df %>%
  select(Seed, Dataset, all_of(names(metric_mapping))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(metric_mapping)),
    names_to = "metric_code",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      metric_mapping[metric_code],
      levels = unname(metric_mapping)
    )  )

# 2. Compute paired Wilcoxon tests & calculate bracket (x, y) coordinates
stat_test <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Value ~ Seed, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Seed", step.increase = 0.10)

seed_palette <- c("Seed 42" = "#2B5C8F", "Seed 112" = "#D95F02", "Seed 123" = "#7570B3")

# 3. Plot Boxplots with 'ns' displayed on brackets
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Seed, y = Value, fill = Seed)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Paired gray lines tracking individual datasets across the 3 seeds
  geom_line(aes(group = Dataset), color = "gray60", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Seed), size = 2.2, shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, fill = "white") +
  # Explicitly show 'ns' on brackets (hide.ns = FALSE)
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    tip.length = 0.015,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    size = 3.6,
    hide.ns = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = seed_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = seed_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F2F4F7", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E9ECEF", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Value",
  )
```
